expected_behavior_change: WebSocket open, Doorbell, online, startup and resume share one bounded single-flight catch-up task.
Canonical HEAD selects warm, missing-delta or checkpoint-plus-tail recovery without periodic business polling.
Verified candidates become the active LKG atomically and AppliedSeq becomes visible only after commit.
Offline and restart retain the previous valid LKG; Doorbell payload never becomes canonical truth.
MFP Pad and MFP Mobile share the same sync coordinator and Store Port HeadSeq contract.
non_goals: No production sync endpoint, auth/device binding or public routing.
No Store Kernel, Pricing, Order, Payment, Fulfillment, Print, Customer or Keeta authority change.
No v2 client-state or legacy SMM authority import.
No Builder, OTA, merge, deploy, cutover or legacy SMM decommission.
